title: 3.1 crashes instantly on Pixel 6
symptom: When trying to open the app built from 3.1 (master) on a Pixel 6, it crashes instantly. Rebooting and reinstalling did not help.
cause: The issue appears to be related to using the white theme on some phones.
fix: Switch to dark mode in the app preferences. For those unable to open the app, build and install the 3.1 beta 1 branch, turn on dark mode in Preferences, then build and install 3.1 (master).
evidence_quote: seems to be issue on some phones. switch to dark for now
